notes: Build 47 — the uncommitted work of the last four sessions, split into reviewable feature commits and audited slice by slice. Fixes a case where a card holding two weddings, read through a marginal reader, could copy the other wedding's clips into this couple's folder without ever asking. Hardens the updater: a quote in a release note can no longer break the update feed, an update can no longer install over a running deletion, and a build your Mac is too old to run is refused instead of installed. No change to how footage is copied or verified.
